chunks: O you enfolded in your mantle

key_terms.الْمُدَّثِّرُ: The Enfolded One; a title for the Prophet referring to one wrapped in a garment, symbolizing preparation or concealment before prophetic mission.

ai.seo_question: Who is addressed as Al-Muddaththir in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the transition from the Meccan period of silent preparation (Tayammun) to the public proclamation (Dawah), with 'Al-Muddaththir' interpreted as the Prophet being enfolded in divine command or his cloak of prophethood. The subsequent command to 'purify your garment' is often understood by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as referring to spiritual purity and freedom from polytheistic associations, establishing the foundation for the message of Tawhid.
